A ₹137 Crore Supreme Court Order Is Putting This IT Company In Focus

India’s digital infrastructure story is no longer limited to banks, enterprises and data centres.

The judiciary is becoming a major technology customer too.

Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd. has recently secured a ₹137.15 crore project from the Supreme Court of India for the Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 728 servers to host the Case Information System software of District Courts.

That is a significant business development — but there is more.

Dynacons also secured a US$6.83 million international digital transformation project from the Commonwealth of Dominica.

Its H1 FY27 numbers showed:
• Revenue from operations: ₹865.05 crore, up 27% YoY
• EBITDA: ₹94.77 crore, up 37%
• PAT: ₹49.61 crore, up 17%
• Orders on hand as of July 2026: ₹3,104 crore

The company operates across data centres, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking and managed IT services.

The interesting question is execution.

Large technology projects can create strong revenue visibility, but they also demand disciplined delivery, working-capital management and continuous technology upgrades.

Can Dynacons evolve from an Indian IT infrastructure player into a larger digital transformation partner across government and global markets?
